scope: Data01 feasibility: can real CO2 concentration replace the NO2/CO proxy? Two one-day pulls, 8 lead times each, Ionian bbox only.

findings.title: CAMS global greenhouse gas forecasts
findings.resolution: high-resolution forecast approximately 9 km (catalogue text); delivered grid 0.1 degree (VERIFIED in pulled file)
findings.temporal_extent: 2024-03-01 to present (catalogue updated 2026-11-06); daily forecast run, 5-day lead time, 3-hourly steps
findings.latency: run a few hours behind real time; initial conditions from a 4-day-old analysis (satellite CO2 latency)
findings.surface_values: form help text: select variable carbon_dioxide and model level 137 for surface values

findings.system_changes: upgraded about once a year (resolution, species, accuracy); catalogue recommends the EGG4 reanalysis for consistent long-term series

interpretation: VERIFIED: modelled surface CO2 is available at each airport's 0.1 deg cell, 3-hourly, daily, from 2024-03-01, CC BY 4.0, with the project's existing ADS credential.

VERIFIED (2 days only): airport cells sit 2-9 ppm above an open-sea cell and show a diurnal cycle (night/early-morning highs, e.g. PVK 452.8 at 00 UTC vs 427.1 at 09 UTC on 2026-10-30), consistent with boundary-layer accumulation of land fluxes.

VERIFIED (2 days only): the peak tourism day (2025-08-15) is about 10 ppm lower than 2026-10-30, the opposite of tourism pressure; summer vegetation uptake and the annual growth of about 2-3 ppm/yr dominate.
ASSUMPTION: at 9 km the airport's own emissions are a minor part of the cell signal; whether the CAMS emission inventory includes airport/aviation surface emissions was not checked.
RISK: forecast system upgrades about yearly break series consistency; values are a forecast (lead time 0-21 h from a 4-day-old analysis), not an observation.

RISK (review round 2): the 0.1 deg 'airport cells' are coastal land-sea mixes (land fraction EFL 28 %, ZTH 44 %, CFU 56 %, PVK 64 %); the EFL cell centre is sea and the PVK cell is mainland (EL631 Aitoloakarnania), not EL62.

RISK (review round 2): at this scale CO2 is a regional carbon-cycle signal and is anti-correlated with tourism pressure (region mean 424.75 ppm on peak day 2025-08-15 vs 435.90 ppm on 2026-10-30). 'Airport cell minus one sea cell' is a land-vs-sea contrast, not an airport signal.
RISK (review round 2): forecast product upgraded about yearly; not trend-homogeneous. EGG4 reanalysis (0.75 deg) is the trend-stable product.
status: VERIFIED (access, content, licence). Not adopted for Data01 (review round 2; D-031 stands). Possible separate regional background-CO2 indicator is a PROPOSAL pending owner decision.
review: Independent review 2026-11-06, round 2: files, conversion and figures reproduced exactly; do NOT adopt as Data01 headline; at most a separate regional background-CO2 indicator outside Data01 and the composite, with a robust marine background (regional percentile, not one cell).
